brief.goal: Settle a correct, minimal Zsh change that puts `/opt/homebrew/bin` first in PATH exactly once, so re-sourcing `~/.zshrc` does not grow PATH.

candidate.text: Proposal — add before prompt setup in `.config/zsh/zshrc`: `export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"`. This is safe to run on every source because Zsh removes duplicate PATH entries automatically.

brief.context: Prior discussion: the user saw PATH grow on every `source ~/.zshrc` and asked for a fix that keeps Homebrew first. macOS on Apple Silicon, Homebrew at `/opt/homebrew`. The proposal was drafted quickly and is untested.
